newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: DRAKA BUYS SPANISH CABLE MAKER CEDEGALSA.
newsitem.headline: DRAKA BUYS SPANISH CABLE MAKER CEDEGALSA.

text.p: Draka Holding NV said on Wednesday it had reached agreement earlier this month to buy fellow cable maker Cedegalsa in Spain.
The company is based in the province of Galicia and posts an annual turnover of around 45 million guilders.
Draka said it had also tentatively agreed to take a 34.8 percent stake in Oman Cable Industry, a producer of low voltage cables with annual sales of 45 million guilders.
In January it finalised the previously announced takeover of France's GIFI Group, which posts turnover of about 130 million guilders per year.
Draka said its 1996 net profit had risen by 23 percent to 80.7 million guilders on a four percent higher group turnover of 1.26 billion.
Partly because of the recent acquisitions, the company expects further profit and turnover growth in 1997.

Draka said it saw the European cable markets stabilising this year but added that if an expected recovery of the French and German economies failed to emerge, a slight fall of European markets could not be excluded.
Cable markets in the Far East and the U.S. were expected to show continuously favourable trends, Draka said.
